findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed two dented cans of broth and chicken dumpling soup on an aisle shelf. The dents were observed on the seams of the cans. Discussed with PIC and cans were pulled from the shelf. Ensure that the packaging of all foods are in good condition to protect the integrity of the contents.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There was an open air cooler that appears to no longer be functional near the main entrance. If there aren’t any future plans for usage of the cooler, be sure to discard the cooler, as it is no longer necessary to the daily operations of the facility.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.114 Maintaining Premises, Unnecessary Items and Litter. The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter.
